reason: Schema and engine-command rules for cornerstone-platform surfaced in the CP-8 design review (three fresh reviewers found blockers each time a new table, grant or command was drafted without these). Future migration or CLI designs need them up front, and the timetable fortnight rule was relayed by Nimish.

The stop gate in the CP-18 session repeatedly reported that the engine package was not installed, with the fix printed in the hook message. Nothing in the engine skill tells the next session to run the install first, so a schema or CLI change would hit the same block.
